thread:
maria: Canary in eu-west failed during pull: `manifest unknown` when kubelet tried to fetch image.
kevin: Which image/tag?
maria: `registry.aws.redwood/redwood-serving:2026-03-canary` — kube events show `Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = manifest unknown`.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] publish attempt blocked: provenance TTL expired for `redwood-serving:2026-03-canary` (attestation timestamp 2025-11-02T04:12:03Z). See logs: ```ERROR: provenance-check: attestation expired (age 121 days) -> reject publish```
sam: Hmm we recently tightened ECR lifecycle and attestation TTLs. Could the image have been GC'd because it wasn't replicated with an immutable pin?
maria: ECR report shows image exists in account but tag unbound; manifest digest still present? UI shows lifecycle rule removed the `canary-*` tag after 30d retention.
jess: If the digest is still in the registry we can retag to `redwood-serving:canary-temp` and re-run publish, but deploy-bot will still refuse if attestation is stale.
kevin: Can we refresh attestation without rebuilding? We have the original digest; cosign can re-sign if we have the SBX key, but key rotation policy blocks that in CI.
oncall-sre: Manual re-sign is allowed with release lead approval. Also, republishing a tag with a new attestation will bump the manifest timestamp and might satisfy deploy checks.
sam: Ops risk: manual sign -> audit + note in release. Prefer rollback canary to previous stable digest for now and queue a republish of the same digest with refreshed attestation.
maria: Agree. Rolling back canary now. Which digest is stable?
kevin: Prev stable digest: `sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4g5h6i7j8k9l0m1` (deployed in prod on 2026-01-10).
oncall-sre: I'll kick the rollback job. maria, can you validate image pull after rollback? I'll also open an incident ticket for republish + attestation refresh.
maria: Running rollback now: `kubectl set image deployment/serving serving=registry.aws.redwood/redwood-serving@sha256:0a1b2c...`.
maria: Pods are coming up, image pulled OK. :thumbsup: 
jess: I'll prepare the republish procedure doc and include cosign re-sign steps and required approvals. Draft steps: ```1) verify digest exists
2) request release lead sign-off (ticket #REQ-482)
3) use ops-runner to cosign: cosign sign --key kms://projects/... --artifact sha256:...
4) push tag redwood-serving:2026-03-canary -> deploy-bot will re-try publish
``` 
kevin: Also add check: if attestation < 90d, allow automated republish; otherwise require manual sign-off. That should prevent future surprises.
sam: Can we change lifecycle rule to keep tagged manifests for 14 days after creation plus retain any manifest that has an attestation? File follow-up in infra: INFRA-ttl-tweak.
oncall-sre: Filed INFRA-1287 with proposed rule and rollback playbook attached.
maria: Thanks — closing this thread. We'll keep canary on the stable digest until republish is complete. :eyes:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback job completed for `serving` in eu-west. status: success.
